specimens.name: Deep monochrome CRT diagnostic display housing fragment
specimens.notes: Deep beige/gray CRT housing with convex blank green-gray glass and visible case depth/ventilation; no controls, text or lighting hardware.

specimens.name: Deep color CRT test-monitor housing fragment
specimens.notes: Second visibly deep CRT family with blank dark curved glass and apparatus-grade housing; no screen content or console.

specimens.name: Rack-mount plug-in electronics module
specimens.notes: Single removable vented electronics module with two extraction handles and captive front hardware; no full rack, screen, cable or text.

specimens.name: Replaceable PCB cassette/service module
specimens.notes: Closed slide-in service cassette with two extraction tabs and six small colored diagnostic lenses; no exposed PCB artwork and no active glow.

specimens.name: Coax diagnostic connector-panel fragment
specimens.notes: Small isolated panel fragment with exactly four matching coax/BNC-style sockets; no cables, controls or labels.

specimens.name: Multipin diagnostic service-interface module
specimens.notes: Compact module with one rectangular multipin connector, one circular multipin connector and two capped mechanical test-access points; no screen or lighting substitution.

specimens.name: Grouped early-LED status-bar module
specimens.notes: Narrow diagnostic module with exactly eight small physical lenses grouped 3 red, 2 amber, 3 green; lenses are colored but not emitting glow.

specimens.name: Small specialized monochrome LCD readout module
specimens.notes: Compact thick-bezel early monochrome LCD hardware with blank dark-green window; no digits, text, backlight glow or surrounding instrument.
